en.headline: Tang writes to New York Times over arrest article
en.dek: The security secretary said a report on a recent arrest distorted the facts and was unrelated to press freedom.
body: Secretary for Security Chris Tang Ping-keung has written to the editors of the New York Times to oppose an article about a recent arrest in Hong Kong, local media reported on Friday night.

The article, headlined in English as a report that a Hong Kong journalist was arrested after covering a gathering linked to the 2019 protests, was published earlier by the newspaper. Tang said the piece distorted the facts and made groundless accusations against the national security law and the Safeguarding National Security Ordinance, according to accounts of the letter.

He said safeguarding national security was a priority for every country, and that the United States itself had a large body of national security legislation. Negative comment on Hong Kong's laws amounted to double standards, he wrote.

On the enforcement action mentioned in the report, Tang said it was lawful, based on evidence and carried out strictly in accordance with the law, and was unrelated to the person's political stance, background or occupation. Police investigations indicated the arrested person was suspected of spreading false information and smearing the government and police with lies, with intent to incite hatred, an alleged offence under section 24 of the Safeguarding National Security Ordinance, the letter said.

Tang said the case had nothing to do with press freedom. He said human rights, including freedom of the press, were protected under the Constitution and the Basic Law, and that both security laws required rights to be respected. The people concerned have been arrested; they have not been convicted.

zh.headline: 鄧炳強去信《紐約時報》反對拘捕報道
zh.dek: 保安局局長指有關本港近日拘捕的報道歪曲事實，並強調案件與新聞自由無關。
body: 保安局局長鄧炳強周五去信《紐約時報》編輯，就該報早前一篇關於本港拘捕行動的報道表示強烈反對和譴責，本地媒體周五晚報道了信件內容。
該文英文標題指一名香港記者在採訪與2019年反修例示威相關的集會後被捕。鄧炳強在信中說，文章歪曲事實，並對《香港國安法》及《維護國家安全條例》作出無稽指控。
他表示，維護國家安全是每個國家的首要任務，美國本身亦有大量國安法例，對香港相關法例的負面言論屬雙重標準。
就報道提及的執法行動，鄧炳強說行動完全合法，基於證據並嚴格依法進行，與涉案人的政治立場、背景或職業無關。信中稱，警方調查顯示被捕人涉嫌散播虛假訊息，並以謊言抹黑特區政府和警方，意圖煽動仇恨，涉嫌違反《維護國家安全條例》第24條。相關人士已被拘捕，案件尚未有裁決。
鄧炳強又說，案件與新聞自由無關。他指出，包括新聞自由在內的人權在《憲法》和《基本法》下受到保障，兩項國安法例亦訂明維護國安須尊重和保障人權。
